snippet.title: Deep Sea Puzzle(Deep Sea Bubble): Unique Physics Match-3 Game (Android)
snippet.description:
Dive into the mysterious ocean with Deep Sea Puzzle! 🌊 (Available now on Android!)

This is not your average match-3 game! 
Experience the satisfying, unique physics where cute marine creatures float upwards instead of falling down. It's simple to play, yet deep enough to challenge any puzzle fan.

---
⬇️ DOWNLOAD LINK (Google Play Store - Android)
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kanapoko.deepseapuzzle&hl=en

---
